frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Forums, parcours et certificats
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Developper forums, moderation, parcours, inscriptions, progression et certificats.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Final oral interview can be represented by a calendar event until full evaluation integration is ready.
